provenance.method: Pearson pairwise-complete raw features, no imputation or scaling
provenance.scope: descriptive feature correlation over all 15351 genes; not held-out prediction accuracy

provenance.error_bars: sample SD across 10 fold means; five seed importances averaged within each fold
provenance.normalization: Each fitted RF importance vector sums to 1 over all 383 features; top30 NOT renormalized

clustering: Independent row/column average linkage on Euclidean correlation profiles, optimal_ordering=True
layout_update: Bottom single-row feature-group legend on LEFT; horizontal Pearson correlation colorbar on RIGHT. Original data, clustering, palette, typography and 16x11 panel geometry retained.
